intro: If you want to be able to walk to both Karon and Kata beaches, and still have a sea-view pool on the roof for just a few hundred to a thousand-odd baht, KK - Karon Kata Boutique Hotel is a name budget travellers keep coming back to. It is a small 42-room boutique hotel on Karon Road, opened in 2019. The highlight is a 6th-floor rooftop pool with a Sky Bar looking out over the sea and mountains. It is about a 300 m walk to Karon Beach and 500 m to Kata Beach. From approx. ฿900/night. Score 8.8 from 118 reviews.

body.html: What sets KK Karon Kata apart from similarly priced stays is its location halfway between two famous beaches. The hotel sits on Karon Road, about 300 m from Karon Beach and 500 m from Kata Beach — so when you step out, you simply pick which beach to hit that day. Karon is a wide, quiet white-sand beach (calmer than Patong), while Kata is a touch livelier with its restaurants and bars. Restaurants, convenience stores and massage shops are all within walking distance, so you don't have to rely on a vehicle constantly the way you do at many stays on the southern side of the island.

The feature guests mention most is the rooftop pool on the 6th floor. It's a small pool with a lounge zone looking out over the Andaman Sea and the surrounding hills, and many reviewers say the view is better than they expected for a hotel at this price — a fine spot for sunset in the evening. Beside it is the Sky Bar @Rooftop, open from midday into the evening, so you can order a drink and relax poolside. The pool is open roughly 07:00–20:00. It's not a large swimming pool, but it's a relaxing corner that punches well above the room rate.
"The room was clean and the bed comfy, but the best part was the rooftop pool — going up for a drink and watching the sun set over the sea, at this room price, is more than worth it."

There are 42 rooms in total, from a Superior of about 20 sqm up to a 30 sqm Deluxe, Family rooms, and a roughly 54 sqm Two-Bedroom Suite. They're decorated in a simple, modern style, all with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, free Wi-Fi and an en-suite bathroom. Most reviews praise the rooms as clean and the beds comfortable, with some larger than expected for the price. Staff score highly on service (around 9.1) — many guests describe the team as friendly and helpful with arranging transport and recommending things to do. Airport transfers and a beach shuttle are available too.

In the interest of honesty: because this is a small budget hotel, room quality isn't consistent across the board. A number of reviews mention musty smells from the AC or air ducts in some rooms, slow bathroom drainage, and hygiene at breakfast where flies sometimes appear. Not everyone runs into these, but they're worth knowing before you set expectations. The pool is also on the 6th floor (a lift ride away), and the hotel doesn't sit directly on the beach — you walk a short slope down to the sand. A score of 8.8 from 118 reviews is still very strong for a budget hotel in this area, a sign that the location and rooftop pool outweigh the small weak spots.

To be straight with you, KK Karon Kata is not a beachfront resort or a luxury hotel with every amenity, and it doesn't try to be. It's a small boutique hotel selling a walk-to-two-beaches location, a sea-view rooftop pool, and a genuinely affordable price. If you're in Phuket for the beaches, want a clean place on a modest budget, and aren't fussed about luxury, this delivers value that's hard to find around Karon-Kata. But if you want a beachfront resort, spotless brand-new rooms, or big-hotel facilities, look at pricier options.

A tip from following the reviews here closely: ask for a higher-floor room and specify you'd like one without any musty smell when you book, since room quality varies. Head up to the rooftop pool in the evening before it closes at 20:00 — the light is lovely and it's quieter then. And if you plan to explore the island, ask the hotel to arrange transport or a scooter rental, as public transport on the Karon-Kata side is limited.

honestSummary: KK - Karon Kata Boutique Hotel suits travellers who are in Phuket for the beaches and want a clean, walk-to-two-beaches base on a modest budget. Its strengths are the central Karon-Kata location, the sea-view rooftop pool and the friendly service. But accept that it's a small budget hotel: room quality is inconsistent, there are occasional musty-smell and cleanliness issues, and it isn't beachfront.
honestChecks: If you want a beachfront resort where you step out onto the sand — this sits on Karon Road, about a 300–500 m walk down to the beach → if beachfront is essential, look at a resort right on Karon or Kata beach instead.
If you're particular about brand-new, odour-free rooms — room quality is inconsistent and some rooms have a musty smell → ask for a higher floor, specify at booking, and check the latest reviews.
If you want to explore all over Phuket — public transport on the Karon-Kata side is limited → plan to rent a scooter or have the hotel arrange transport in advance.

faqTitle: FAQ — KK - Karon Kata Boutique Hotel Phuket

faq.q: Where is KK Karon Kata in Phuket, and can you walk to the beach?
faq.a: It's at 6/1 Karon Road, Karon, Mueang Phuket. It's about a 300 m walk to Karon Beach and 500 m to Kata Beach — right in the middle of the two. Restaurants, massage shops and convenience stores are within walking distance. Phuket Airport is roughly a 50–60 minute drive.

faq.q: How much does KK Karon Kata cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start at around ฿900/night for a roughly 20 sqm Superior Double, rising to Superior Triple, Deluxe (30 sqm) and a Two-Bedroom Suite (54 sqm) for families or groups. Rates climb in high season — always compare a few platforms and check the total before booking.

faq.q: What is the rooftop pool at KK Karon Kata like?
faq.a: It's a pool on the 6th floor with a lounge zone and a Sky Bar, looking out over the Andaman Sea and the hills. It's open roughly 07:00–20:00. It isn't a large lap pool, but it's a relaxing sunset spot that many reviews say is more than worth the room price.

faq.q: Who is KK Karon Kata best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for couples, groups of friends and budget travellers who are here for the beaches and want to walk to two of them. Ideal if you want a clean place with a sea-view pool at a low price. Less suited to those expecting a beachfront resort, spotless brand-new rooms, or big-hotel facilities.

faq.q: Is there anything to know before booking KK Karon Kata?
faq.a: Because it's a small budget hotel, room quality is inconsistent — some reviews mention musty AC/air-duct smells in certain rooms, slow drainage, and occasional flies around breakfast. Ask for a higher-floor room and specify you'd prefer one without a musty smell, and check the latest reviews before you book.

faq.q: Is it convenient to stay here without your own vehicle?
faq.a: The hotel itself is walkable to the beach and restaurants, so it's convenient for short distances. But for Patong, Old Town or other beaches, public transport on the Karon-Kata side is limited — use Grab or rent a scooter. The hotel offers airport transfers and a beach shuttle it can arrange in advance.
